gap.title: A step toward: Order 3 plane: no circuit of at most 64 AND/OR gates of fan-in two (distinct earlier wires) computes incidence and has a double re-read incidence (step 2 of 2)
gap.statement: ¬∃ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (63 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size ∧ x1.size ≤ (64 : ℕ) ∧ (∀ (x2 : ℕ) (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x1.gates[x2]? = Option.some x3 → (x3.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ x3.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ ∃ (x5 : ℕ) (x6 : ℕ), x3.inputs = [x5, x6] ∧ x5 ≠ x6 ∧ x5 < (26 : ℕ) + x2 ∧ x6 < (26 : ℕ) + x2) ∧ (∀ (x2 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x2) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (x3 = x4 ∨ x3 = x4 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x3 = x4 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x3 = x4 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))) ∧ x2 (Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x3) = Bool.true ∧ x2 (Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x4) = Bool.true) ∧ (∃ (x2 : ℕ → Bool), (∀ x3 < (26 : ℕ), x2 x3 = Decidable.decide (x3 = (13 : ℕ))) ∧ (∀ (x3 : ℕ) (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (x5 x6 : ℕ), x1.gates[x3]? = Option.some x4 → x4.inputs = [x5, x6] → (x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → x2 ((26 : ℕ) + x3) = ((x1.wires (List.ofFn fun (x10 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (↑x10 = (0 : ℕ)))).getD x5 Bool.false && x2 x6 || x2 x5 && (x1.wires (List.ofFn fun (x10 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (↑x10 = (0 : ℕ)))).getD x6 Bool.false)) ∧ (x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → x2 ((26 : ℕ) + x3) = (x2 x5 || x2 x6))) ∧ x2 x1.output = Bool.false) ∧ ∃ (x2 : ℕ → Bool), (∀ x3 < (26 : ℕ), x2 x3 = Decidable.decide (x3 = (0 : ℕ))) ∧ (∀ (x3 : ℕ) (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (x5 x6 : ℕ), x1.gates[x3]? = Option.some x4 → x4.inputs = [x5, x6] → (x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → x2 ((26 : ℕ) + x3) = ((x1.wires (List.ofFn fun (x10 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (↑x10 = (13 : ℕ)))).getD x5 Bool.false && x2 x6 || x2 x5 && (x1.wires (List.ofFn fun (x10 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (↑x10 = (13 : ℕ)))).getD x6 Bool.false)) ∧ (x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → x2 ((26 : ℕ) + x3) = (x2 x5 || x2 x6))) ∧ x2 x1.output = Bool.false

gap.sketch: Step 2 of 2 of a checked cut of L-meta-1482. Its sibling steps: L-meta-2600. Together they give the parent; the parent's own sketch: The exact least size at the plane of order 3: the star circuit has 64 gates. This side: no circuit of at most the stated size. SIZE, corrected 24 Nov: NOT a session-sized search by plain SAT; in-house controls show about eight times more time per gate (a 10-input case: 9 gates in 162 seconds, 12 gates unanswered in 3 minutes).
